agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Lildozer fainted after two Bulldozes and Ice Shard against Ponyta; its forced replacement finished safely. It acted on every available turn and was never used as a no-action pivot.
Bushtank fainted after four Razor Leafs into Eelektrik. The sacrifice produced a free Ohmnomnom entry and preserved Croakatoa, Bugatti, and Birdlaw for the terminal sequence.
Ohmnomnom converted 13 HP into two legal fresh-entry Fake Outs plus one damaging move before fainting to Sunflora. This enabled Birdlaw to enter for free and sweep the last two opponents.

All seven switches were forced replacements, matchup entries, or the verified sleep escape. Every voluntary entrant acted before leaving; there were zero true no-action reversals and zero consecutive switch stalls.
The win required 26 decisions and 19 executed attacks, five fewer decisions than the rejected sleep-stall win. No shorter line was verified to improve survival or reliability.

correct_choices: The Ohmnomnom-to-Bugatti-to-Ohmnomnom relay contained Fake Out, Bug Bite, and another fresh Fake Out; it was productive tempo, not switch spam.
Bugatti escaped sleep immediately after acting once and survived at 31 HP; no status-prevented action occurred.
Birdlaw entered only after Ohmnomnom fainted, then used four consecutive Aerial Aces to finish Sunflora and Dustox without switching.
The authoritative terminal state verified victory with Croakatoa 13 HP, Bugatti 31 HP, and Birdlaw 32 HP.
agent_review.next_test: Run unchanged-bundle Clone 2 from the identical opening; repeat the no-action-switch, fresh-only Fake Out, deterministic-status, incapacitated-entry, and survivor audits.
